# uptimeify_escalation_config (Resource)

The organization's escalation webhook (one per organization; organization token with write access). Creating it adopts the stored configuration and applies the configured values. The webhook URL also drives the organization webhook channel (`Organization Webhook`), so do not manage that channel as `uptimeify_notification_channel` too. Destroying it sets `is_active = false` and clears the URL, which deactivates the organization-level webhook channels; the row stays. Import with the organization id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "escalation_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "uptimeify_escalation_config" "this" {
  webhook_url           = "https://hooks.example.com/uptimeify"
  webhook_method        = "POST"
  webhook_timeout       = 10
  expected_status_codes = "200,202,204"
  is_active             = true

  webhook_headers_wo         = { "X-Api-Token" = var.escalation_token }
  webhook_headers_wo_version = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `expected_status_codes` (String) Comma-separated, e.g. `200,201,202,204`. Unset = keep.
- `is_active` (Boolean)
- `organization_id` (Number) Unset = the token's organization.
- `webhook_body_template` (String) JSON template with placeholders such as `{{websiteName}}`. Unset = keep.
- `webhook_headers_wo` (Map of String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only request headers (they may carry tokens). Sent with create and whenever `webhook_headers_wo_version` changes; replaces all stored headers. Authorization, Cookie, Host, X-Forwarded-* and Proxy-* are refused by the API.
- `webhook_headers_wo_version` (Number) Change to resend `webhook_headers_wo`.
- `webhook_method` (String) `POST`, `PUT` or `PATCH`. Unset = keep (default `POST`).
- `webhook_retry_attempts` (Number) 0 to 10. Unset = keep (default 3).
- `webhook_retry_delay` (Number) Seconds, 0 to 60. Unset = keep (default 60).
- `webhook_timeout` (Number) Seconds, 1 to 30. Unset = keep (default 30).
- `webhook_url` (String) Target URL (http/https, must resolve to a public address). Give it normalized (as `new URL()` prints it, e.g. with the trailing `/` of a bare host). Unset clears it and switches the organization webhook channel off.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The organization id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The organization id
terraform import uptimeify_escalation_config.this 2
```
